## Dynamic Edge Women in STEM Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

This scholarship will be given to two women (one in Michigan and one in Tennessee) who plan to pursue degrees or certifications in STEM.

At Dynamic Edge, every team member understands the power of positive communication and genuine empathy, resulting in superior client service.&nbsp;Helping people isn’t just a goal – it’s an integral part of the Dynamic Edge culture and workplace.&nbsp;As a leading IT services provider in Ann Arbor and Nashville, Dynamic Edge is also keen to support its local communities in new and innovative ways. This principle not only lies in the workplace but also in their communities.&nbsp; Today’s U.S. STEM workers remain male-dominated.&nbsp;While women comprise nearly half of the entire workforce, only 27% of the STEM workforce identify as women.&nbsp;Still, those figures are starting to shift prominently.&nbsp;Gender diversity in STEM will pay dividends down the road as many different types of people will be required to solve the most complex challenges. The Dynamic Edge Women in STEM Scholarship will award $2,000 each to two women (one in Michigan and one in Tennessee) who plan to pursue STEM degrees or certifications. To apply, please describe who is an unexpected person (inside or outside of STEM) who influenced your decision to pursue a technical field? Tell us a specific story that shows how they impacted you.

## Jacques Borges Memorial Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

This scholarship will support one student of Haitian descent who is pursuing a civil engineering degree and who has large ambitions for the future of their community.

My father, Jacques Borges, devoted his life to helping the Haitian community and acting as a mentor to younger Haitians, paving the way for their upward mobility in his community before he passed away. His early passion for giving back led him to become a civil engineer where he brought a spirit of excellence to every project he was involved in, both professionally and personally. He was passionate about finding solutions for the problems he saw in the world and providing mentorship and sponsorship to those who shared his civil engineering and community service passion.&nbsp;My father didn’t rest until he saw a tangible change in his community and there wasn’t a soul he wouldn’t help.&nbsp; To honor my father’s legacy and the work he did to give back to his community as a civil engineer, the Jacques Borges Memorial Scholarship will be awarded to one student of Haitian descent who is pursuing a civil engineering degree and who has large ambitions for the future of their community and a relentless desire to learn, grow and truly make a difference. To apply, you must: Be of Haitian descent. Be a high school senior or current undergraduate student. Plan to study civil engineering (if a high school senior) or be actively enrolled in a civil engineering program. To apply, please write about why you’re passionate about becoming a civil engineer, the various problems you’d like to address in your community, and how you believe you can contribute to bringing forth solutions to these issues in honor of my father.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

Essay prompt: Why are you passionate about becoming a civil engineer? What are some of the problems you’d like to address in your community? how do you believe you can contribute to the solution to these issues? Essay requirements: min length 400, max length 600

## Mark Caldwell Memorial STEM/STEAM Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

This scholarship is intended to honor the memory of Mark Caldwell by encouraging students with financial need to work toward STEM or STEAM careers.

Mark Caldwell was a bright, charismatic, and thoughtful person. After graduating from Springboro High School in Ohio, Mark earned his Bachelor’s degree from Devry Institute of Technology. He worked 35 years as an electrical engineer, specializing in robotic integration within the packaging industry. His career took him all across the globe.&nbsp; Above all else, Mark was a loyal friend and a kind person. He treated everyone equally, with an open spirit and with dignity. Mark created the types of bonds that lasted decades. To remember and honor the memory of Mark Caldwell, the Mark Caldwell Memorial STEAM Scholarship will support first-generation high school students in CA or OH who plan to pursue a STEAM degree. To be eligible for this scholarship, you must be a low-income, first-generation high school senior in CA or OH with a min 3.0 GPA who plans to pursue a STEAM degree. Preference will be given to students from Springboro High School in OH or Woodlake Union High School in CA. While not required, it's a plus if you are active in F.I.R.S.T Robotics, Destination Imagination, the maker community, or similar activities. To apply, please write about a time when, through tremendous hardship, you achieved something great in your life. Please go into detail about the strategies, skills, and techniques you employed to overcome the obstacles between you and your goal.

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

Shon Harris WIS Memorial Scholarship provides financial assistance to female undergraduate and graduate students working on a degree in information security.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to female full-time sophomores, juniors, seniors, and graduate students who are working on a degree in computer science with a focus on information security.
- Minimum GPA is 2.5 for undergraduates or 3.0 for graduate students.
- Applicants must submit a 500-word personal statement that includes a short autobiography, information on their chosen academic program, a statement of interests, and their goals in information security.
- Selection is based on that statement, academic excellence, work experience, community service, extracurricular activities (including those in cyber security and information technology), and relevant certifications and clubs.

## Soliant Sunrise Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

Soliant Sunrise Scholarship recognizes and rewards, with scholarships, undergraduate students who submit outstanding essays on software engineering.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This competition is open to students entering or enrolled full-time at a 2- or 4-year college or university in any state.
- Applicants must submit an essay of 400 to 450 words on how software engineers and developers can take a more active role in adhering to technology ethics and protecting those affected by the solutions they build.
- They must have a GPA of 3.0 or higher; entering freshmen must have taken either the ACT or SAT test.
- Selection of the scholarship winner is based on the quality and thoughtfulness of the essay.

## Thomas M. Eustis Memorial Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

Thomas M. Eustis Memorial Scholarship provides financial assistance to high school seniors in Sacramento, California who plan to attend college in the state and major in science or mathematics.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to seniors who are graduating from high schools in the Sacramento City Unified School District and who have an academic average of "B+" or higher.
- Applicants must be planning to enroll at an accredited college or university in the state and major in a field with a science or mathematics focus.
- Selection is based primarily on that essay, financial need, extracurricular activities and community involvement, incentive, leadership qualities, cooperative spirit, positive attitude and enthusiasm, and a well-rounded, outstanding high school experience.
- Special consideration is given to applicants graduating from C.K. McClatchy High School.

## VWEA Member Dependent Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

VWEA Member Dependent Scholarship provides financial assistance to children of members of the Virginia Water Environment Association (VWEA) who are working on an undergraduate degree related to wastewater at a school in the state.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to children of VWEA members who are currently enrolled as full-time undergraduate students at a college or university in Virginia.
- Applicants must be working on a degree in civil or environmental engineering or physical environmental science.
- They must have a GPA of 2.75 or higher.
- Selection is based on the essay (25%), work and research experience (25%), extracurricular activities (25%), and academic performance (25%).

VWEA Rising Freshman Scholarship provides financial assistance to high school seniors who plan to attend college in the state and work on an undergraduate degree related to wastewater.

## Walter J. Clore Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

Walter J. Clore Scholarship provides financial assistance to residents of any state who are interested in studying wine-related areas at a college in Washington.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to residents of any state who are enrolled or planning to enroll full or part-time at a college or university in Washington.
- Applicants must be interested in studying viticulture and/or enology, wine business management, wine-related hospitality, food science, or other wine-related disciplines.
- They must have a GPA of 3.0 or higher.
- Preference is given to undergraduates, although graduate students may apply.
- All applicants must submit an 800-word essay about themselves, including such topics as what sets them apart from others, why they have chosen their particular area of study, their future plans and career goals, their interests and experiences in the wine grape industry, their plans for improving or enhancing the wine and grape industry, why they should receive the scholarship.
- Selection is based on academic merit, leadership abilities, and interest in the study of enology and/or viticulture; financial need is not required but may be considered in the selection process.

## William P. Elrod Memorial Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

William P. Elrod Memorial Scholarship provides financial assistance to high school seniors and college undergraduates who are members of the Technology Student Association (TSA) and have performed outstanding service in the field of technology.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to TSA members who are enrolled or planning to enroll at a 4-year college, university, or career and technical school.
- Applicants must have performed services for TSA at the local, state, or national level for at least 1 academic year and must have attended and participated in at least 1 TSA state or national conference.
- Selection is based on those essays, transcripts (GPA of 3.0 or higher), SAT or ACT scores, and 3 letters of reference.

## WSADA Bright Future Auto Tech Scholarship

**Категория:** `stem`

### Описание

WSADA Bright Future Auto Tech Scholarship provides financial assistance to students enrolled in an automotive technology program at a community college or technical institute in Washington.

### Тема эссе / промпт (по данным каталога)

- This program is open to students currently enrolled in an automotive technology program at a public community college or technical institute in Washington.
- Applicants must visit the service department of an automobile dealership in the state and include a report on their visit with their application.
- They must also submit a brief essay on why they want to be an automotive technician.
- Selection is based on the essay (50%), their report on their dealership visit (25%), and a letter of recommendation from an instructor or adviser (25%).
